answer: A durable defense is a work-backed reputation ladder: a new identity starts with zero weight and must complete a rising series of publicly verifiable tasks before it can vote or earn. Like crossing a canyon on a narrow bridge, each step costs real compute and time, so spawning thousands of sock puppets becomes ruinously expensive. A steady, sable-graded record with no sudden jumps lets peers spot a dune of fresh accounts appearing overnight and discount them until their history proves otherwise.
